heroTitle: Don’t let our community space be
heroIntroduction: Hackney Council is trying to sell 28–32 Ellingfort Road to private developers. Together, we can keep it in community hands.
storyHeading: A building full of history—and future.
storyParagraphOne: For decades, 28–32 Ellingfort Road was home to Hackney Chinese Community Services: a place for connection, support and belonging.
storyParagraphTwo: It can serve the community again. Once a public building is sold to private developers, getting it back is nearly impossible. We’re asking Hackney Council to stop the sale and work with local people to return it to community use.
campaignQuote: Neighbourhoods need places where people can meet, organise, learn and look after one another.
emailActionText: A personal message works best—or use our ready-made template. It only takes two minutes.
shareActionText: Share the campaign with neighbours, friends and family. Every new voice adds pressure.
joinActionText: Have ideas, time or useful skills? We’d love to hear from you. Everyone is welcome.
closingText: Ask Hackney Council to protect 28–32 Ellingfort Road and put its future back in the hands of the community.
